name: institutional-v3
description: Built to measure ANSWERS, not retrieval, once a generative model is writing them. v2 asks questions in the documents' own words and scores whether the right document came back; what a person complained about was different: correct answers discarded as 'not found'. So v3 asks about the same corpus the way people ask - a paraphrase that changes most of the words of the clause, a date or year written another way than the document writes it, a number spoken as a word, two questions in one, 'is it mandatory' - and, as important, questions that look answerable and are not (an entity or a year the documents do not cover) which a more willing system must still refuse. Score it with `evaluate --chat-path` so a general-knowledge reply to a question the documents answer is counted, and read `correctness` (the expected answer's key facts are in the answer) beside `false_abstentions` and `missed_abstentions`. Be clear about the coverage: v3 adds two documents to v2's corpus (staff attendance and leave, the bus circular), but many of its cases ask about facts v2 also asks about, in another wording, so it overlaps v2 and differs from it mainly in how it is scored and in its compound, wording-variant and refusal cases, not in new ground. Offline (extractive answerer) it is a regression baseline for the quoting path; it only becomes interesting with a model.

cases.question: How often do I need to show up to class to be allowed to sit exams?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. No word of the clause: 'show up' for attendance, 'sit exams' for the end-semester examination.

cases.question: I was unwell and my presence is at 70 percent. Can I still sit the exam?
cases.expected_answer: condonation on medical grounds with a certificate
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE + CONDITIONAL. The figure is the asker's, so the answer has no figure to match; correctness falls back to content words.

cases.question: What happens if my attendance is under sixty-five percent?
cases.expected_answer: condonation is not permitted below 65 percent
cases.notes: NUMBER WORD in the question; the document writes 65.

cases.question: What's the maximum number of books a postgraduate student can have out at once?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Have out at once' for 'borrow at one time'; the document says 'six' as a word.

cases.question: How much is the penalty for returning library books late?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Penalty' for 'fine'.

cases.question: When do I have to be back in the hostel on Saturday nights?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Be back' for 'curfew'.

cases.question: By which date must I sign up with the placement cell?
cases.notes: DATE. The answer will say '15th August' or 'August 15'.

cases.question: What do I pay if I lose my bus pass?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Lose' for 'lost pass', 'replaced' for 'pay'.

cases.question: My family earns two lakh rupees a year. What financial help can I get?
cases.expected_answer: means-tested aid covering the examination fee in full and up to 40 percent of hostel charges
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. Income given in lakh; the document writes 300000 rupees.

cases.question: How many days do I have to file a complaint after something happens?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Complaint' for 'grievance'.

cases.question: Who handles an appeal against the committee's decision, and how soon must it be made?
cases.notes: COMPOUND, one clause.

cases.question: What do I need to bring to be let into the exam hall?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. No figure: correctness falls back to content words.

cases.question: How often do I have to change my account password?
cases.notes: NEW FACT (v2 asks how long a password must be, not how often it changes). One figure in the middle of a clause.

cases.question: How many days of casual leave do employees get each year?
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Employees' for 'staff member'.

cases.question: When does a staff member's arrival count as late?
cases.notes: TIME.

cases.question: What is the last day to submit applications for financial aid?
cases.notes: DATE. The answer will say '30th September' or 'September 30'.

cases.question: Which academic year does the bus circular cover?
cases.notes: YEAR RANGE. A model writes '2024-2025' or '2024 to 2025'.

cases.question: What is the B.Tech ECE tuition fee for 2024-25?
cases.notes: TABLE + YEAR RANGE. The year is in the document's title, not in the row.

cases.question: When must fees be paid by, and what is the late surcharge?
cases.expected_answer: before the last working day of July; 500 rupees per week after that date
cases.notes: COMPOUND, one passage.

cases.question: What is the minimum attendance for exams, and how many books can an undergraduate borrow?
cases.notes: COMPOUND across two documents. A model is given it whole.

cases.question: How much is the library fine per day, and what is the hostel curfew on weekdays?
cases.notes: COMPOUND across two documents.

cases.question: Is it mandatory to register with the placement cell, and what is the deadline?
cases.expected_answer: Yes: a student must register before 15 August of the final year, and registration is not automatic
cases.notes: 'Is it mandatory' must not be read as a follow-up; COMPOUND.

cases.question: How is earned leave accrued, and what is the most that can be accumulated?
cases.expected_answer: 2.5 days per completed month, up to 300 days
cases.notes: ONE CLAUSE, TWO FIGURES, in the middle of a multi-chunk document.

cases.question: What happens to a probationer whose attendance is below the minimum?
cases.expected_answer: the probation is extended by six months
cases.notes: PARAPHRASE. 'Probationer' for 'staff member on probation'; the document writes 'six' as a word.

cases.question: What attendance does a scholarship holder need compared with the exam requirement?
cases.expected_answer: 85 percent, higher than the 75 percent for examinations
cases.notes: CROSS-DOCUMENT. Two thresholds, two documents.

cases.question: Which programme has the lowest tuition?
cases.notes: TABLE comparison: no cell states the answer.

cases.question: How much does an M.Tech CSE student pay for tuition?
cases.notes: TABLE lookup of a cell v2 does not ask (v2 asks M.Tech CSE's exam fee, not its tuition).

cases.question: What is the tuition fee for the PhD programme?
cases.notes: ENTITY SWAP. The fee table lists B.Tech and M.Tech only; a more willing system must not answer with a row that is not PhD's.

cases.question: What is the hostel fee for B.Arch students?
cases.notes: ENTITY SWAP. No B.Arch row.

cases.question: How many days of casual leave do students get each year?
cases.notes: ENTITY SWAP. Casual leave is for staff; answering '12 days' is the failure.

cases.question: What does a bus pass cost for the 2023-24 year?
cases.notes: YEAR SWAP. The circular supersedes the 2023 one and gives only 2024-25's price.

cases.question: What is on the cafeteria menu this week?
cases.notes: UNRELATED. Nothing in the corpus.
